items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: my dear friend, Jimmy... We had been drinking buddies, also, at the time of my association with his orchestra.

ctx.x: Tom, and now Frank was in the driver's seat and took the whole top floor with an entourage and his army of people.

The office had talked Tommy Dorsey into making up -- their standing feud over the years with his brother Jimmy, and it was then that it was the Dorsey Brothers, and we opened the Paramount Theatre -- great publicity for Frank and his picture.

The engagement was a smash success -- and it was four weeks, a month -- and that was the first time, a first for Joey Bishop. Frank had heard Joey Bishop and liked his work, so that was the comedian that was on the bill, that was the first time for Joey Bishop on Broadway.
